correctness.rationale: The original RESULT.md gave incorrect *triangle identifiers* for three valid commutator words. A fresh independent reconstruction found that the originally named triangles (1,2,6), (2,7,10), (0,11,12) each reduce to the empty relator. The three words actually occur at triangles (0,7,8), (0,4,7), (4,8,23), respectively. The staged complete replacement RESULT.md corrects those factual locations while preserving and fully re-proving the one final theorem. Independent graph/face enumeration gives 1,404 faces (27,243,540,405,162,27); stage-toggle matching in the exact order gives 672 pairs and 60 critical cells (1,3,56), 4,698 oriented cover incidences, and an acyclic directed Hasse diagram. F2 boundary ranks (26,214,270,135,27) yield Betti vector (1,3,56,0,0,0). Tree/presentation elimination leaves generators on edges (11,13),(1,18),(11,20), 214 eliminated edges, 540 relators with histogram 485 empty, 30 length4, 21 length6, 4 length8. All are exponent-balanced; three corrected nontrivial commutator words force Z^3. The 2D Morse CW model then implies integral H1=Z^3, H2=Z^56 and no higher homology. The zero integral second differential follows from abelianization, not mod-two rank alone.

Kahle gives only an abstract dimension-two bound; exact optimal original-poset matching is a strictly stronger finite extremal certificate.
Independent exact reconstruction confirms each c_i equals the integral Betti rank, giving a degreewise optimal witness.
value.rationale: The natural object is the open-neighborhood complex of the canonical six-regular ternary three-cube. Despite being a 5D 1,404-face triangulation with an abstract 2D deformation retract already known from Kahle, a matching of the *original* face poset attaining all Morse lower bounds is not automatic. Its exact minimal critical vector (1,3,56,0,0,0), fully explicit optimal acyclic matching and group calculation give an independently useful topological benchmark and practical finite Morse model. It is not a renaming, trivial small-instance normalization check, or merely a recomputation of the known graph-walk group. The value is limited to a motivated natural exact case and does not require a paper-sized family theorem.
residual_risks: The work is a single finite case and does not settle matching optimality for larger Hamming graphs.
